usedFor: Notion is where the team writes things down and Slack is where they hear about it. “New Page Is Created” in Notion can run “Send Message”, so a new doc or brief reaches the channel.

bestTemplate.name: “New Page Is Created” in Notion, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: A new page is a clear thing to announce, and “Send Message” can post to a channel, user or thread, so the page lands where the team reads.

watchOut: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits for approval today. “Send Interactive Message” adds buttons, which only helps if someone is there to answer.
